images.title: House from crossing arcs
images.purpose: Show the roof point A of the house found by crossing two 5 cm arcs from B and C, with every border line 5 cm.
images.composition: One house figure centred with wide white space.
images.exact_structure: A square base BCED with B top left, C top right, E bottom right, D bottom left, each side 5 cm. Roof point A above BC found by two grey #6B7280 arcs of radius 5 cm, from B and from C, crossing at A, marked with a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot. Roof sides AB and AC drawn teal #0072B2, each 5 cm. A curved arc of 5 cm radius with centre A from B to C bulges down into the square, drawn amber #E69F00. Exactly 1 square, 2 roof sides, 2 construction arcs, 1 curved arc.
